name: Corcima Castle
title: Corcima Castle
summary: The Viamontian Corcima Castle at 83.2N 50.4W, divided into wards on separate sea stacks that rise sheer from the frozen sea (z 0). The central ward and the Platinum ward (north) share a 200 m mesa. The Copper (west), Silver (east) and Gold (south) wards stand on 160 m stacks. The wards carry 12 m dark stone walls, 34 gold-spired 26 m corner towers, nine 26 m lighthouse towers, T'thuun pillars and four Destroyed Portals to Zaikhal. The kit covers only the central 3x3 landblocks (x 12096-12672, y 44160-44736), and every camera stays inside that area.

shots.standingOrder: Hover 212 m above the frozen sea south-east of the island looking steeply down at the floe, then tilt up to reveal Corcima Castle crowning its 200 m sea stacks, the sun behind the lens; drift 6 m, nothing near.
shots.notes: Tilt reveal. The camera hovers 212 m above the frozen sea and floe, south of the east ward, 235 m south-east of the central ward. It tilts from -50 deg to -3 deg, and Corcima Castle rises into frame on its 200 m sea stacks, gold spires catching the high late-morning sun from behind the lens. The castle enters the frame at t 4.1, so the 5.5 s window from t 3.5 keeps it in frame 87 % of the time. Verified (check.mjs, full take flown): take 0-9 s: AGL 212..212 m, nearest drawn 71.99 m (static 0x41E7#18 0x01003611), vmax 1.05 m/s, LOS blocked 0/37, subject in frame 54%, over water 60%; edit 3.5-9 s: AGL 212..212 m, nearest drawn 71.99 m (static 0x41E7#18 0x01003611), vmax 1.05 m/s, LOS blocked 0/23, subject in frame 87%, over water 35%; flight cinema peak 1.04 m/s (cap 12), max tracking gap 0.01 m.

shots.standingOrder: Cross the central ward north-westward 62 m above the courtyard, keeping its gold-spired towers and walls in frame through vertical; stay 30 m above every spire.
shots.notes: Pass-over. The camera crosses the central ward north-westward 62 m above the courtyard (36 m above the spire tops), the gimbal slewing through vertical. The four lighthouse towers, the gold-spired walls and the courtyard pass beneath, with the sea 260 m below at the frame edges. shots.standingOrder: Fly north 214 m above the frozen sea along the chasm between the central and east wards and sweep past the gold-spired south-east corner tower 24 m off its east face; keep 20 m from the walls.
shots.notes: Fly-by. The camera flies north at z 214, 180 m above the frozen sea, through the chasm between the central and east ward stacks, and sweeps past the gold-spired south-east corner tower 24 m off its sunlit east face. The sheer stack walls fall to the floe below. The nearest object is the ward wall at 21 m. shots.standingOrder: Spiral down clockwise from 85 m to 45 m above the central ward, closing from 70 m to 50 m out, until the courtyard, its towers and the sea far below fill the frame; stay 19 m above every spire.
shots.notes: Spiral descent. The camera spirals clockwise from 85 m to 45 m above the central ward, closing from 70 m to 50 m, and arrives over the courtyard, its towers and the sea beyond. It stays 19 m above the spire tops and 20 m from the lighthouse tower.
